title: Pword visual world — Home + Editor
question: Desk-first Operate redesign. Roll key d9380516. Degraded note: full challenger catalog reached the API; fuse judgments are below. Pick a world, re-roll, or take the category standard.

options.label: Galley Proof Desk
options.lineage: print-shop galley proofs on a working desk
options.thesis: Pword is a proof desk: Home is a short stack of galleys; the Editor is the active proof on the board — write, mark, leave.
options.viewport: Home: quiet list as stacked galley slips + one Start writing action. Editor: A4 sheets as proof pages; slim tool rail as proof marks, not a Word ribbon.
options.risk: Can slide into cream-paper cliché if the proof language is soft instead of editorial and exact.

raised.raise: Deploy discipline: one clear gesture from compact Home into the full writing field — no decorative half-states.
Registration furniture: precise hairlines, mono metadata, one grotesque for UI — printed, not soft-brand.
Focus dimming: while writing, chrome yields; the active page owns brightness and attention.
Depth without boxes: hierarchy from layering and type, not card shells everywhere.
State as quiet language: save/error/quota speak in the status line like proof notes, not toast theater.

options.label: Typewriter Platen
options.thesis: The product is a writing machine: Home is the paper stack beside it; Editor is the platen with the sheet locked in.
options.viewport: Home: machine silhouette + paper stack list. Editor: sheet held in a platen frame; toolbar as machine levers — sparse, tactile, high contrast.
options.risk: Most familiar writing metaphor in this category — can feel costume if chrome becomes novelty keys.

options.label: Deployable Sheet
options.thesis: Home is the folded packet; one pull deploys the writing field into a precise crease grid of pages.
options.viewport: Compact Home packet → Editor as fully deployed tessellated sheet with A4 cells along the crease graph.
options.case: Strong audience ID with paper craft; weaker Operate clarity — fold states can obscure open/write/save.
options.risk: Novelty fold UI fights desk-first calm if every transition is a performance.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.thesis: Every screen is a plate on uncoated stock: registration marks, hairlines, one grotesque, stamp of human authorship.
options.viewport: Home as 4-up plate index of documents; Editor as full plate with A4 content registered to the sheet.
options.case: Wins craft clarity as an interface language; loses audience ID vs student/writer desk rituals.
options.risk: Can feel like a portfolio site rather than a daily writing tool.

options.label: Title-Card Wall
options.case: Fuses poorly for desk-first: poster browsing fights write-now. Home would become the product.
options.kept: Focus dimming — neighbors yield to the active item.

options.label: Cracktro Queue
options.case: Audience mismatch (demoscene) and no-box void fights A4 paper task clarity.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.case: Reads as coding IDE, not a writing desk; paper pagination becomes alien.
options.kept: Keyboard-first state spoken in the transcript/status line.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.case: Surreal construction obscures private writing jobs on both axes.
options.kept: Sectional air — deep gaps between chrome strata and the page.

canonCard.label: Calm local doc editor
canonCard.thesis: What Notion-lite / Docs-adjacent tools ship: clean shell, paper or canvas, restrained accent — executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Top bar + toolbar + centered page; Home as simple recent list.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from category defaults by design — the standing exit.
